title: The crawler redesign (Cosmin Stefan, 2012 GSoC) and the spider add-on
description: A 2012 GSoC crawler redesign in zaproxy, and what later happened to the spider code: a zap-extensions add-on in 2022 and removal of the deprecated spider from core in 2026.

chapters.title: 2012: a new spider package in core
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists a crawler redesign with session support (Cosmin Stefan) as a 2012 Summer GSoC project. The wiki lists goals including a"redesigned (or possibly replaced) site crawler". A zaproxy commit by cosminstefanxp dated 2012-05-29 is titled"New SpiderParam in org.zaproxy.zap.spider. Modified extensions to accommodate with change."

chapters.title: Summer 2012: features added
chapters.text: Commits by cosminstefanxp in the spider paths show the work step by step:"Added support for depth of crawling."(2012-06-06),"Added support for Frames and IFrames. Added tests for Frames and IFrames."(2012-06-13),"Started work on Form handling. Added parser for HTML forms. Integration with rest of spider. Handling of simple text input fields. Added corresponding tests for Wavsep."(2012-07-03),"Removed old and unused Spider-related Paros Proxy packages."(2012-07-12) and"Add support in Spider for parsing of robots.txt files for finding more resources. On dev_spider branch."(2012-08-06).

chapters.title: 2017: functionality moved to a Spider extension
chapters.text: A zaproxy commit dated 2017-01-04 is titled"Move Spider functionality to Spider extension".

chapters.title: 2022: a spider add-on; 2026: deprecated spider removed
chapters.text: In zap-extensions, a commit dated 2022-01-20 is titled"feat: spider: Add spider add-on with SVG href parsing"and one dated 2022-04-27 is titled"feat: Spider Migration". In zaproxy, a commit dated 2026-01-23 is titled"Remove deprecated spider"; its file list includes org/zaproxy/zap/spider/Spider.java and SpiderParam.java. The spider add-on remains in zap-extensions.
